design: All600 completed default fine-step trials. Compute manifest finished-minus-started elapsed seconds grouped by dt; no deletion of slow/fast trials. Use finest-step distribution only as an illustrative inverse-dt scaling estimate for two proposed halvings, not a measured future runtime.
limitations: Concurrent node contention/setup and network activity affect runtime. Manifest elapsed differs from allocated CPU time; summed elapsed is worker-hours, not a new allocation guarantee. No simulation launch.
